simple.meaning: הֵרוֹן (hêrôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “pregnancy.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: הֵרוֹן (H2032) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 3:16, with occurrences in Genesis, Ruth, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֵרוֹן (H2032) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in הֵרוֹן (H2032) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: הֵרוֹן (hêrôwn) / H2032 is traced through Genesis 3:16, Ruth 4:13, Hosea 9:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
